description: This source file defines a ToastService class for displaying toast notifications in a Blazor web application. It manages showing and hiding toast messages with different levels (info, success, warning, error) and uses a timer to auto-hide the toast after a set duration.

classes.name: ToastService
classes.description: A service class managing toast notifications, including showing messages, auto-hiding them after a delay, and disposing of resources.

methods.name: ShowToast
methods.description: Triggers the display of a toast message with a specified level and starts the countdown timer.

methods.name: StartCountdown
methods.description: Initializes and restarts the countdown timer to auto-hide the toast after a delay.

methods.name: SetCountdown
methods.description: Configures the timer, setting the interval and event handler for auto-hiding the toast.

methods.name: HideToast
methods.description: Event handler called when the timer elapses, invoking the hide event.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the Timer resource when the service is no longer needed.
